picks.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
picks.why: Markets price a September rate hike; the Fed's path drives borrowing costs, currencies, and asset valuations.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Whether inflation reexceeds 4.5% shapes real wages, policy credibility, and the odds of further tightening.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state one-time wealth tax would test mobility, revenue, and constitutional limits of taxing capital.

picks.question: Will the Iranian regime fall before 2027?
picks.why: Iranian regime change is a low-probability, high-impact tail for oil supply and global energy prices.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: An AI-assisted Millennium Prize result would be evidence machines are contributing frontier mathematical research.

picks.question: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI before 2027?
picks.why: An AGI declaration carries contractual and regulatory consequences well beyond the underlying technical claim.
